title.narrative: Activity under preparation Education - Budget Support II

description.narrative: The Action¿s overall objective is to support the Government¿s policy and ambition to deliver quality, efficient, equitable, affordable and inclusive social services for all, as reflected in the national education strategic plan 2022-2026. It will seek to improve both the equal access to (specific objective 1), and the quality of (specific objective 2) basic education (i.e. primary and secondary), especially for vulnerable groups including girls, through: 1) support to school infrastructures and equipments, 2) enhancing data-driven decision and policy making and planning at all levels through support to more efficient and effective education management information systems (EMIS), 3) strengthening teacher professional development in particular for inclusive and special education, and 4) enhancing the Ministry's capacity to integrate digital learning strategic actions to leverage technology effectively for educational purposes.
